purpose: Teach: 抹殺/卑劣/撃退/狙撃/弛緩/摂理/拘置/朝方

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、政治家の抹殺事件史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered the history of political assassinations in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant opening. A gentle confirmation framed as a question—showing she's read his work. Steady pace, thoughtful tone. Not probing, just acknowledging.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、卑劣な手段で勝利した戦例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I focused on military victories achieved through underhanded tactics.
lines.style: Focused and precise. Slight hesitation before the topic, then settling into it with quiet conviction. A little formal—academic register. Not defensive, just serious about the subject matter.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、侵略軍の撃退史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you handled the history of repelling invasions in your paper as well, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured tone. Leaning forward slightly with genuine curiosity. Acknowledging the scope of what he's tackled. A pause between clauses to let the weight land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、要人狙撃事件の社会的影響を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I examined the societal impact of high-profile assassinations.
lines.style: Clear and steady. He's moving into another layer of his thesis. Slightly less hesitation this time—warming to the conversation. Academic but not stiff. Eyes meeting hers briefly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 神経の弛緩反応を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You addressed the physiological response to nervous system relaxation in your work?
lines.style: Engaged but not surprised. A slight lift in her voice suggesting genuine interest in this particular thread. Leaning in slightly—this detail matters. Pace still unhurried.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、神の摂理を巡る宗教思想を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I looked at religious philosophy surrounding divine providence.
lines.style: Calm, deliberate. A thread connecting back to something deeper. Not evasive, but moving into more philosophical territory. Slightly longer pause before answering—choosing words carefully.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下の拘置所制度を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered the detention system under wartime conditions in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective, almost contemplative tone. A moment of weight in her delivery—this is serious subject matter. Not accusatory, just acknowledging what he's chosen to study. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、朝方の交通事故統計を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I analyzed morning traffic accident statistics.
lines.style: Quiet, composed conclusion. A slight exhale before answering. He's answered fully now. Not rushed, but with a sense of wrapping up. Sincere and measured through to the end.
